problem: If $S={0,1,2,3,4,5}$, which collection of subsets of $S$ is a partition of $S?$

feedback.problem: If $B={3,5,7,11,13,15},$ which collection of subsets of $B$ is a partition of $B?$
feedback.worked_solution:
A partition of a set $B$ is a collection of non-empty subsets of $B$ where every element of $B$ is contained in *exactly* one subset. 

Of the given collections, only ${{3},{5,7},{11,13,15}}$ is a partition.

The rest of the collections are not partitions:

- ${∅,{3},{5,7},{11,13,15}}$ is not a partition because the subset $∅$ is empty.

- ${{3,5,7},{5,11,13,15}}$ is not a partition because the element $5$ appears in two subsets.

- ${{3,11},{5,7,11},{3,11,13,15}}$ is not a partition because the element $11$ appears in three subsets.

- ${{3,5,11,13,15}}$ is not a partition because the element $7\in B$ does not appear in any subset.
